summary: Match each route summary only to its immediate route-level detail panel.
reason: Provider detail panels nest ETC/ETC2 toll tabs with the same class; recursive selection must not shift later alternatives or erase their stops, forecast links and restrictions.
call_sites: Summary rows correspond to immediate route panels.
validated_outcome: The minimal two-alternative nested-tab fixture fails under the old selector and passes after the fix; all three alternatives in the archived real provider page retain stops, forecast URLs and warnings.
